messages:
Marta: Quick spike — we need a trimmed 'heatscape' battlecard for inbound leads + webinar follow-ups. Focus: latency/cost differential vs managed endpoints, predictable unit econ, and fallback/resiliency hooks. Need a 1-line opener, 3 econ bullets, 2 rebut lines for 'we already use cloud X', and a short SDR script.
Sam: I can pull benchmark snippets — p50/p95/p99 latency + cost per 1M tokens vs typical managed endpoints. Will drop numbers into the doc. ETA EOD.
Jordan: Draft opener attempt: "Ship the same model expectations, with predictable inference economics — Redwood Inference: production-grade serving that doesn’t surprise you." Thoughts?
Priya: Strong tone. Replace any hard %/dollar claims unless Sam can back them. Maybe: "lower unit costs with production controls" instead of exact figures.
Sam: Agreed — keep public-facing copy conservative. Proposed econ bullets for the battlecard (internal): 1) Predictable p99 latency via autoscale + routing; 2) Workload-aware caching and batching that reduces token spend; 3) Quantization & per-route tuning for sustained cost wins.
Eli: SDR script (short): "Curious — how are you tracking per-call unit economics with your current managed endpoints? Teams we talk to cut unit costs with batching+prefix caching — happy to share a baseline." Very convo opener.
Marta: Nice. Can someone draft two quick rebut lines to "we use a cloud provider because it’s easier"?
Jordan: Rebut A: "Managed is easier until tail latency or cost surprises hit production SLAs. Redwood gives the same simple API plus predictable scaling and built-in fallbacks."
Jordan: Rebut B: "Need private networking/keys? We offer Dedicated and Private deployments with the same API and rollout controls." :thumbsup:
Priya: Webinar angle suggestion: "Bench -> Production: turning a benchmark into 99th percentile reliability." Format: 20-min demo (3 scen.), 10-min Q&A. Demo scripts: cold-start, automated fallback to compatible model, and routing-by-policy example.
Sam: I'll attach the bench snippets and a CSV cost comparison in the doc: https://redwood-internal/bench/heatscape-23 (internal).
ops-bot: Document created -> https://redwood-internal/docs/marketing/heatscape-battlecard-draft (edited). :page_facing_up:
Marta: Owners: Sam (bench/data), Jordan (soundbites + rebut table), Eli (SDR + webinar script), Priya (webinar ops). Please add comments by Fri 5pm.
Eli: I'll add 2 cold email variants + a 30s voicemail script.
Jordan: I'll write a 30s launch post script and a 3-line social lead.
Marta: Quick public-post note: avoid naming competitors directly in public channels/posts; internal battlecard can enumerate. Keep public copy benefit-led and verifiable. :lock:
Sam: Noted — will flag any candidate metrics that need legal sign-off.
Priya: Can we meet Wed 10am to review? I'll send a calendar invite.
Marta: Meeting confirmed. Thanks all — moving this to review.
